mapper.insert: insert into users (id, username, password, email, phone, create_time, update_time) values(#{id},#{username},#{password},#{email},#{phone},NOW(),NOW())
mapper.update:
UPDATE users
username = #{username},
email = #{email},
phone = #{phone},
avatar = #{avatar},
bio = #{bio},
update_time = NOW(),
WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: select username, password, email, phone, avatar, bio, follower_count as followerCount, following_count as followingCount, article_count as articleCount, favorite_count as favoriteCount, create_time as createTime, role, status from users where id = #{userId}
